assets.visualDescription: A pale pixel-font glyph sheet on a dark background, with letters, numerals, punctuation and arrow-like symbols arranged in rows.
A starry blue-black scene with a pale moon, dark silhouette, jeweled crown, red roses and a long diagonal sword.
Ornate pink lettering reading “Champions of Krynn” over the starry moon-and-sword scene.
An ornate Dragonlance wordmark with the subtitle “Fantasy Role-Playing Vol. 1” over the moonlit sword-and-roses scene.
